candidates.name: Co-oriented, scale-persistent edges
candidates.mechanism: Fault displacement juxtaposes density and magnetic blocks; weak or buried strands can leave parallel field gradients.
candidates.layers: RTP magnetics, isostatic gravity, existing 3DEP scarp summaries and conductivity
candidates.signature: Squared-cosine gradient agreement at sigma 1 and 3 pixels, with within-field direction persistence
candidates.confounder: Lithologic contacts, lava boundaries, interpolation/survey seams
candidates.novelty: Cross-field direction agreement, not the prior magnitude-only multi-azimuth worms

candidates.name: Repeated drainage displacement
candidates.mechanism: Small strike-slip strands displace several crossing channels with a consistent sign.
candidates.layers: Raw 3DEP terrain + USGS NHDPlus HR flowlines
candidates.signature: Paired upstream/downstream crossings of a label-free scarp, not a ridge along one channel
candidates.confounder: Stream capture, fan avulsion, ditches, hydrography error
candidates.novelty: Explicit network pairing instead of a scalar tectonic/fluvial ratio
candidates.status: DEFERRED; product and footprint checks required

candidates.name: Lithology-conditioned contrast
candidates.mechanism: A scarp/field edge through a unit interior may indicate displacement rather than a mere unit contact.
candidates.layers: GeMS/SGMC unit polygons, gravity, RTP and terrain
candidates.signature: Contextual unit-interior and boundary-relative edge features; no hard geological negatives
candidates.confounder: Faulted contacts, coarse polygons and unmapped lithologic changes
candidates.novelty: Unit polygons as competing explanation, not rasterized SGMC fault labels
candidates.status: DEFERRED; exact release and extent need checking

candidates.name: Depth-corrected thermal residual
candidates.mechanism: Temperature exceeding a depth/conduction baseline may support advective upflow under cover.
candidates.layers: GDR1391 temperatures/depth/chemistry + USGS conductive heat flow + GDR1390 conductivity
candidates.signature: T minus surface-plus-q-depth-over-k, with measurement quality and structural corroboration
candidates.confounder: Lateral aquifer transport, mixing, pumping, solar heating, uncertain conductivity
candidates.novelty: Correct for depth/background heating, not absolute-temperature smoothing
candidates.status: BLOCKED; exported chemistry CSV lacks depth metadata
